scope.database: Disposable full schema, WAL synchronous=2; setup/seed excluded from counters/workMs
scope.workMs: Sum of synchronous 100-request batches, 1ms yields excluded
scope.cpu: process.cpuUsage covers workload and yields; sampled profiles also include startup
scope.counters: Workload-only calls/durations; compiled Statement identity via WeakSet, no bind values recorded; weak proxies avoid retaining baseline statements
scope.parsing: JSON only; cookie parsing, hashing and Date.parse represented in CPU samples, not individually instrumented
limits: No real HTTP socket/gateway composition, users or credentials
Warm static SQL working set; cache eviction is not part of performance measurement
No contending writer, busy-wait distribution, FTS/background/large-history workload or heap/GC profile
Existing SQLite transaction snapshots remain authoritative; no stronger immediate cross-transaction revocation guarantee
